notes.title: EA Version will be released on November 19th, 2021
notes.content:
Hell everyone!

We're here to remind you only two weeks left until Dr Iwan: Evolution in Early Access on November 19th! For those of you still wondering, the price tag will be ＄6.99 for the US / €5.69 for the EU.

[previewyoutube=n5Hls9cEbQ8;full][/previewyoutube]

With half year development after first public demo, we have improved Dr Iwan: Evolution in many side according to players' advice.

Remake map system
We completely remaked map system and now it is changeful and full of challenges than before. And we remaked all the background too.

More Species
We created 3 more species with 24 new blend stone than demo version. They bring this game more fun.

Better UI design
UI is an other part that we have rebuilt in last half year. We hope that new UI will bring better experience to you.

Cheers!
